faqs.q: What gaming platforms and eras are covered on Run On Console?
faqs.a: Our platform directory covers 15 comprehensive gaming categories and over 100+ iconic hardware devices: from 8-bit NES and Atari 2600 to modern PC Battlestations, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X, OLED Handhelds, VR/AR, and China Emulation engines (Anbernic/Retroid/Miyoo/Odin).

faqs.q: Can I search for specific devices like Miyoo Mini or PS Vita?
faqs.a: Yes! Use our interactive Device Search & Filter Engine to instantly filter by device name, era, generation, and form-factor.
Hall-Effect controllers use contactless magnets rather than physical friction wipers to track analog stick and trigger inputs, making them highly resistant to stick drift.
